home.title: Nambikkaiyodum mariyaadhaiyodum vaazhkkai thunaiyai kandupidiyungal
home.subtitle: Tamil Nadu Tamil kudumbangalukkaana thirumana sevai. Profile create pannunga, porutthamaana varangalai kandupidiyunga, safe-aa pesunga — muzhusaa free.

pillars.freeBody: Search, interest, message ellaame ovvoru member-kkum free. Paid boost illa, hidden ranking illa.
pillars.safeBody: Unga phone number, sariyaana pirandha thedhi, documents ellaam private-aave irukkum. Unga photos-a yaar paakkalaam-nu neenga dhaan mudivu seiyanum.
pillars.verifiedBody: Ovvoru profile-um publish aagura munnaadi review pannappadum. Enna check pannom-nu badges theliva sollum.
pillars.familyBody: Kalyaanam pannikkapporavanga oppudhal irundhaal mattum dhaan parents profile-a manage panna udhavalaam.

steps.two: Unga profile-um partner preferences-um create pannunga
steps.four: Interest anuppunga; rendu perum ok sonnaa chat pannunga

auth.loginSubtitle: Unga mobile number kudunga. Oru one-time code anuppuvom.
auth.consentTerms: Enakku 18 vayasu illa adhukku mela, <terms>Terms of Use</terms> matrum <privacy>Privacy Notice</privacy>-a ettukkaren.
auth.neverShare: VAIBHAV staff indha code-a eppovum kekka maattaanga. Yaar kittayum share pannaadheenga.

dashboard.nextStepBody: Profile wizard adutha release-la varudhu. Unga account ready.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageBody: VAIBHAV ungalukku eppadi theriyanum-nu select pannunga. Tanglish-na English ezhutthula ezhudhura Tamil.
settings.sessionsBody: Ungalukku theriyaadha devices-la irundhu logout pannunga.

about.title: VAIBHAV pathi
about.body: VAIBHAV Tamil kudumbangalukkaana free, kalyaana nokkudaiya platform. Mariyaadhaiyaana arimugangal, transparent matching, strong privacy controls — idhula dhaan engal kavanam.

howItWorks.title: Eppadi velai seiyudhu
howItWorks.body: Mobile number-oda register panni, profile-a complete panni, partner preferences set panni, matches kandupidiyunga. Rendu perum interest-a accept pannaa VAIBHAV-kulla safe-aa chat pannalaam.

safety.title: Safety centre
safety.body: Online-la sandhikkura yaarukkum panam anuppaadheenga. Unga OTP-a eppovum share pannaadheenga. Platform-ku veliya pesa pressure kudukkuravanga illa panam kekkuravangala report pannunga. Endha profile-aiyum eppo venumnaalum block, report pannalaam.

faq.title: Adikkadi kekkura kelvigal
faq.body: VAIBHAV free-aa? Aamaa — register, search, interest, message ellaame ovvoru member-kkum free.

contact.title: Engala thodarbu kollunga
contact.body: Support contact details launch-ku munnaadi publish aagum.

eligibility.title: Samooga thagudhi
eligibility.body: VAIBHAV oru kurippitta Tamil samoogathukkaaga launch aagudhu. Approval kidaichadhum thagudhi details publish aagum.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.body: Terms of Use legal counsel-oda finalise aagittu irukku; launch-ku munnaadi publish aagum.

privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.body: Privacy Notice legal counsel-oda finalise aagittu irukku; launch-ku munnaadi publish aagum.

errors.generic: Edho thappu nadandhudichu. Thirumba try pannunga.

errors.otp_cooldown: Pudhu code kekkuradhukku munnaadi konjam wait pannunga.
errors.rate_limited: Romba attempts. Konja neram kazhichu try pannunga.
errors.otp_expired: Indha code expire aagiduchu. Pudhusa kelunga.
errors.otp_too_many_attempts: Romba thappaana attempts. Pudhu code kelunga.
errors.consent_required: Continue panna Terms of Use matrum Privacy Notice-a accept pannunga.
